1	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
2	
3	import requests
4	import structlog
5	
6	log = structlog.get_logger()
7	
8	LEDGER_URL = "https://ledger.internal.acme.example/v1/postings"
9	
10	
11	@dataclass
12	class Invoice:
13	    id: str
14	    customer_id: str
15	    subtotal_cents: int
16	    tax_cents: int = 0
17	    ledger_ref: str | None = None
18	    lines: list = field(default_factory=list)
19	
20	
21	def finalize(invoice):
22	    resp = requests.post(LEDGER_URL, json={"invoice": invoice.id, "amount": invoice.subtotal_cents + invoice.tax_cents}, timeout=10)
23	    resp.raise_for_status()
24	    invoice.ledger_ref = resp.json()["ref"]
25	    log.info("invoice_finalized", invoice_id=invoice.id)
26	    return invoice
27	
28	
29	def finalize_once(invoice):
30	    if invoice.ledger_ref:
31	        return invoice
32	    return finalize(invoice)
